newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Brunel share offering to be priced at NLG 36 to 41.
newsitem.headline: Brunel share offering to be priced at NLG 36 to 41.

text.p: The initial public offering of shares in Dutch specialist temporary employment firm Brunel International will be priced at 36 to 41 guilders per share, according to a statement released through the Amsterdam bourse.
A maximum of 7.8 million shares or 40 percent of Brunel's share capital will be offered to investors.
Subscriptions open on June 12 and are expected to close on June 24. The shares begin trading on the Amsterdam bourse on June 25.
Brunel specialises in supplying highly trained temporary staff in information technology and engineering disciplines.
